title: When resistance keeps arguing with Hukam in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind wants reality to arrive on self-approved terms. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru reframes peace as understanding the command already holding everything. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Peace begins when the mind stops arguing with what already stands inside Hukam. Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with.
actionPrompt: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
